decisions.statement: Only the `model` key of a body is read here.
A body that will not parse as json names no model.
A body whose model is no string names no model.
An absent body names no model.
A rewrite has every key the body has beside the model.
A body naming no model is rewritten nowhere.
A body already naming the model asked for is rewritten nowhere.
Nothing here names a model of its own.

definition: the model a request body names, read and written again
